deployments_detail.use: Agentic AI for Customer Experience: conversational, generative and agentic AI digital agents embedded in modernized government contact-center/service experiences to resolve citizen requests automatically. [Google Cloud]

Everest Zero Trust Digital Accelerator: AI-enabled, data-centric zero-trust cybersecurity architecture with AI-driven advanced threat detection, being rolled out to ~1 million users across 187 U.S. Air Force bases worldwide under the Next Generation Gateway program.
deployments_detail.value: $120M task order; 1 million users across 187 bases

deployments_detail.use: Security Operations Center of the future built with Splunk that leverages agentic AI to autonomously detect, isolate and remediate cyber threats for federal agencies. [Splunk (Cisco)]
AI solution to combat fraud, waste and abuse in federal health programs
GDIT "DOGMA" AI (aerial/threat detection, infrastructure protection) + Deep Learning Analytics Center; Google Public Sector AI collaboration

DOGMA (Defense Operations Grid-Mesh Accelerator): edge-to-cloud AI system for air defense that fuses multi-sensor data for real-time threat detection and targeting at the tactical edge; deployable from a laptop to a low-earth-orbit device. Demonstrated with AWS in 2025 and launched as a Mission AI product. [AWS (Amazon Web Services)]

Autonomous Surveillance Towers for U.S. border security: AI-driven, edge-processing towers integrating 5G and satellite comms that automatically detect, categorize and track movement across remote terrain. CBP-certified and physically deployed along northern and southern borders.
deployments_detail.value: 203 towers deployed surveilling 566 miles of border

deployments_detail.use: Luna AI: open-source, cloud-based Digital Accelerator platform that integrates machine learning, NLP and computer vision to turn raw data into actionable insights for government mission analytics.

AI skin-cancer detection tool for the VA: cloud-based, containerized deep-learning image classifier (transfer learning across 7 open-source models, trained on 30,000 lesion images across 7 disease categories) that lets physicians upload lesion images for instant benign/malignant classification. In VA soft-testing toward clinical trials. [AWS (hosting)]
deployments_detail.value: trained on 30,000 lesion images across 7 categories

deployments_detail.use: Expanded collaboration with Google Public Sector to integrate GDIT's Digital Accelerators onto Google Cloud and deliver Gemini-based secure AI/cloud solutions to defense and federal civilian agencies at the tactical edge. [Google (Gemini / Google Cloud)]

Kodiak AI collaboration with General Dynamics Land Systems to integrate Kodiak's AI-powered autonomous 'virtual driver' into ruggedized military ground vehicles (e.g., the Leonidas AGV for counter-UAS/point defense). [Kodiak AI]

NOAA weather forecasting support: GDIT applies machine learning/AI (and operates the WCOSS 2 supercomputers) to support the National Weather Service, including predicting where system outages may occur to keep forecasting infrastructure reliable.
Mission AI solutions for government agencies using Google Cloud [Google Cloud]
Artificial Intelligence at the Tactical Edge demonstration with AWS [AWS]
AI-driven data sharing and analysis for mission-critical battlefield decision making
Generative AI with data control for automated content creation and decision making

Cove AI Ops: AIOps Digital Accelerator using AI/ML and RPA (with ServiceNow) to analyze IT environments, predict and prevent incidents, and automatically take corrective action to modernize government IT operations. [ServiceNow]

VA benefits claims processing modernization: uses AI and automation to digitally convert historical veteran military records and automate data extraction to accelerate benefits claims processing (VCIP program).

AI-assisted software development: GDIT uses generative AI internally across customer missions (border security, weather forecasting) for code generation and validation to speed and improve software delivery.
deployments_detail.value: up to 50% faster new code generation and validation
